title: Patient DCP01, 10x 3' expression multiflex library from PBMCs collected on Day 0, 21, 42, 63
extract_protocol_ch1: For scRNA/TCR-seq of tumor biopsies, single cell dissociated tumor samples were thawed and stained using the Zombie NIR Fixable Viability Kit (Biolegend). The KPL mouse cell line was simultaneously stained with Zombie NIR and mixed with tumor samples at a 2:1 ratio to act as carrier cells. Viable cells were sorted using a FACSAria III flow cytometer (BD Biosciences), centrifuged at 400 x g for 5 minutes, and resuspended in PBS + 5% fetal bovine serum (FBS) at a concentration of ~1500 cells/uL prior to library construction. For scRNA-seq of PBMCs, samples from days 0, 21, 42, and 63 for each patient were tagged using the 10X Genomics CellPlex Kit per manufacturer’s protocols. The cells were pooled and then stained with Zombie NIR prior to flow sorting for viability on a FACSAria III flow cytometer.
For scRNA/TCR-seq, library construction was performed according to the manufacturer’s instructions (10x Genomics) to capture the maximum target cells.

data_processing: For tumor scRNA/TCR-seq, CellRanger 9.0 (10X Genomics) was used to align raw reads to the GRCh38 human and GRCm39 mouse combined reference genome provided by 10X Genomics. For PBMC scRNA-seq, CellRanger 9.0 was used to align raw reads to the GRCh38 human reference genome.
The feature_README.txt provides information for demultiplexing samples

Assembly: Raw reads were aligned and annotated using the 10X reference data, version 2024-A. In brief, raw reads were aligned to the reference human genome GRCh38 (PBMC samples) or combination of GRCh38 and GRCm39 genome (tumor biopsy samples). Transcripts were annotated using GENCODE v44/Ensembl110 for human and GENCODE vM33/Ensembl110 for mouse.
Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files (tsv) and tatrix files (mt) provide raw counts of transcripts for filtered barcodes.
Supplementary files format and content: cvs-delimited text file provide counts associated with specified contig and cell barcode.

metadata.condition: Source non-small-cell lung cancer clinical trial cohort
metadata.source_specimen: Viability-sorted PBMC; original author CellPlex visit partition
metadata.source_identity_policy: Eighteen patient-level GEO accessions each contain three or four distinct day-specific RNA triplets. Exact donor/day filenames, source patient field, original CellPlex README and BioSample agree. GEO accession is a pooled-library identifier, not the visit identifier.
metadata.source_assignment_policy: Use original deposited per-visit barcode partitions. Full native audit verified all within-library visit barcode sets are disjoint, including subthreshold cells. No new tag-threshold assignment or expression-based visit inference.
metadata.source_time_policy: Original trial D0/D21/D42/D63 labels retained as nominal visits. Calendar draw dates and patient-specific drug exposure intervals not independently joined; source_treatment stores visit label, not a measured drug administration event.
metadata.source_modality_policy: All original values audited before typed CellPlex Multiplexing Capture exclusion. Only native Gene Expression features enter RNA totals, QC, annotation and expression geometry. Other repertoire, bulk and human/mouse tumor inputs excluded.
metadata.source_handling_policy: Source describes CellPlex labeling, pooling and viability sorting of PBMC. Original per-patient visit partitions are used; composition and selection effects remain study-level audit targets.
metadata.source_demographic_policy: Individual sex retained literally from the original patient-level GEO record. Age, smoking, tumor genotype, response and exact clinical timing not independently joined or imputed.
metadata.source_processing_policy: Source CellRanger9.0 GRCh38/2024-A GENCODEv44 Ensembl110 native RNA genes retained. Four storage partitions by visit do not change per-sample centroids, estimate learned preprocessing, or imply independent donors.
metadata.split_assignment: unassigned; keep all visits from each participant together

title: Patient DCP19, 10x 3' expression multiflex library from PBMCs collected on Day 0, 21, 42, 63
extract_protocol_ch1: For scRNA/TCR-seq of tumor biopsies, single cell dissociated tumor samples were thawed and stained using the Zombie NIR Fixable Viability Kit (Biolegend). The KPL mouse cell line was simultaneously stained with Zombie NIR and mixed with tumor samples at a 2:1 ratio to act as carrier cells. Viable cells were sorted using a FACSAria III flow cytometer (BD Biosciences), centrifuged at 400 x g for 5 minutes, and resuspended in PBS + 5% fetal bovine serum (FBS) at a concentration of ~1500 cells/uL prior to library construction. For scRNA-seq of PBMCs, samples from days 0, 21, 42, and 63 for each patient were tagged using the 10X Genomics CellPlex Kit per manufacturer’s protocols. The cells were pooled and then stained with Zombie NIR prior to flow sorting for viability on a FACSAria III flow cytometer.
For scRNA/TCR-seq, library construction was performed according to the manufacturer’s instructions (10x Genomics) to capture the maximum target cells.
